body:
## Summary

A `solve --tool claude --verbose` run hit the Claude **weekly limit** and was reported as `CLAUDE execution failed with Claude command failed with exit code 1`, with no reset time. Because the failure was not recognized as a limit, the run was never auto-resumed. A parallel task on the same account that got the limit message did resume at 11:13 UTC.

Claude Code 2.1.303 ended the session without the usual stdout signals: no `rejected` `rate_limit_event`, no synthetic error message and no `result` event. The "You've hit your weekly limit · resets 11am (UTC)" message was written only to the session transcript. The last stdout line was a base64 fragment from the `ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug` dump. Hive Mind trusted a single source (`result` / last line), so it saw only "exit code 1".

After this PR, on a failed exit Hive Mind checks every source it has for Claude, Codex and OpenCode, as requested in [comment 2](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/issues/3570). Any one source is enough to report `limitReached: true` with the reset time. The existing auto-resume, Telegram and PR-comment paths then report "usage limit, resets …" instead of "exit code 1".

Fixes #3570

Case study (timeline, requirements R1–R12, root causes, research, uncertainties): [docs/case-studies/issue-3570/README.md](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-3570-e9ebcaf8355f/docs/case-studies/issue-3570/README.md). The raw log (gzipped, organization and workspace IDs redacted) and the failure comment are in `raw/`.

Upstream report: anthropics/claude-code#103820 ([text](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-3570-e9ebcaf8355f/docs/case-studies/issue-3570/upstream-claude-code-issue.md)). It includes a mock-API reproduction, the workaround and suggested fixes.

## Root causes

1. **Claude Code did not report the limit on stdout.** It exited 1 after the 429, and the limit message reached only the transcript (`isApiErrorMessage: true`).
2. **Claude Code stalled first.** After an auto-compaction at 18:51:17 it wrote nothing for 23.5 minutes. It then handled a 404 that the server had sent at 18:51:37, with `durationMs: 1432110`. The 429 block (server `date` 19:18:37) reached stdout only at 19:30:12.
3. **Hive Mind trusted one source.** In print mode a limit was recognized only from the `result` event or `lastMessage`. `rate_limit_event` was read only in interactive mode. The transcript and the 429 debug headers were never read.
4. **`lastMessage` could be any non-JSON line**, including `ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug` dumps and base64 bodies, and that line became the failure reason.
5. **The same single-source pattern existed for other tools.** Codex checked only stderr/last message, while its `rate_limits` live in the rollout file. OpenCode checked only the last stdout chunk, while the limit was in a `{"type":"error"}` record.

## Solution

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `src/claude.usage-limit-sources.lib.mjs` (new) | `createClaudeUsageLimitEvidence()` collects facts during the stream. `resolveClaudeUsageLimit()` combines five sources on a failed exit: (1) `result` / last line, (2) the synthetic `is_api_error_message`, (3) the transcript tail `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<sessionId>.jsonl`, (4) the last `rate_limit_event` (`rejected` + `resetsAt`), (5) the `ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug` 429 headers (`anthropic-ratelimit-unified-status: rejected` + `anthropic-ratelimit-unified-reset`). An epoch reset is preferred because it carries the date (`Oct 20, 2026, 11:00 AM` UTC). A `rejected` event without `resetsAt` stays the #1924 throttle. |
| `src/claude.lib.mjs` | Wires the evidence into the stream loop. Debug/base64 lines no longer become `lastMessage` or `stderrErrors`. |
| `src/codex-rollout-usage-limit.lib.mjs` (new), `src/codex.lib.mjs` | On a non-zero exit not caused by a signal, reads the last turn of `$CODEX_HOME/sessions/…/rollout-*-<thread>.jsonl`. Either of these counts as a limit: a `token_count.rate_limits` window at `used_percent >= 100` with `resets_at`, or an `error` event with `usage_limit_exceeded`. A limit from an earlier turn does not. The runner now returns `limitTimezone`. |
| `src/opencode.lib.mjs` | Checks every `{"type":"error"}` record's text, not only the last stdout chunk. |
| Verbose output | `🔍 Usage-limit cross-check (issue #3570):` lists each source with `✔`/`·` and its reason. When the tool's own output missed the limit, solve warns `⚠️ Usage limit found only in: …`. |
| `experiments/issue-3570/mock-weekly-limit-server.mjs` | A mock Anthropic API that returns the reported 429 headers, used for the upstream reproduction. |
| `.changeset/usage-limit-cross-check-3570.md` | Patch changeset. |
| `package.json`, `package-lock.json` | Not part of the bug fix. CI's dependency-freshness gate flagged new upstream releases as stale, so `jscpd` goes from 5.4.1 to 5.4.2 (with its platform packages) and the `@opentelemetry/api` lockfile entry from 1.9.1 to 1.10.0. |

Gemini, Qwen and Agent already check their full output on failure, so they were reviewed but not changed.

## How to reproduce

`tests/claude-usage-limit-sources-3570.test.mjs` replays the issue: exit 1, no `result` event, a stale `allowed_warning` `rate_limit_event`, the debug 429 block, a trailing base64 line, and the weekly limit only in the transcript. Before the fix it fails (`limitReached: false`, reason "exit code 1"). After the fix it gives `limitReached: true`, reset `Oct 20, 2026, 11:00 AM` (UTC) and the message "You've hit your weekly limit · resets 11am (UTC)".

## Tests

| Test file | Cases | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tests/claude-usage-limit-sources-3570.test.mjs` | 9 | replay and source tests fail | 9/9 pass |
| `tests/codex-rollout-usage-limit-3570.test.mjs` | 7 | 4 fail | 7/7 pass |
| `tests/opencode-usage-limit-error-record-3570.test.mjs` | 2 | 2 fail | 2/2 pass |

The related suites `codex-process-exit-2745`, `codex-usage-limit-any-event-3215`, `fresh-resume-2888`, `claude-result-error-precedence-2687` and `tests/test-usage-limit.mjs` (78) still pass, and so does `npm run lint`.

## Out of scope

As listed in issue comment 1, these have their own issues: #3572, #3573, #3434, #2837 and #3125.
title: fix(usage-limit): cross-check transcript, rate_limit_event, debug 429 headers, Codex rollout and OpenCode error records before reporting "exit code 1" (#3570)
